name: mobius-frontend
description: Build tooling for the Mobius integration's own Lovelace cards. src/ is the only thing to edit by hand -- dist/ (under ../custom_components/mobius/frontend/) is a generated build artifact, produced by `npm run build`, and is never committed to git at all: it's built fresh at release time (see .forgejo/workflows/release.yml) and baked into the release zip HACS actually installs from.
